records.name: l10n_hu_edi_receive.bills.wizard.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form>
                <group>
                    <field name="l10n_hu_edi_receive_from" string="Datetime range" widget="daterange" options="{'end_date_field': 'l10n_hu_edi_receive_to'}"/>
                    <field name="l10n_hu_edi_receive_to" invisible="1"/>  
                </group>
                <footer>
                    <button name="action_receive_bills" string="Fetch Bills" class="oe_highlight" type="object" data-hotkey="Q"/>
                    <button special="cancel" data-hotkey="X" string="Discard"/>
                </footer>
            </form>
        </field>
